pages.en:
“—Rolled omelet and miso soup for breakfast. No sense spoiling anyone. Right.”

More importantly, I must decide what to do with the intruder who raided my kitchen during the night.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
I’ll make eggs and miso soup for breakfast. I don’t want them to spoil.”
The problem at hand is how to deal with the intruder that attacked the kitchen last night.

pages.ja:
「遠坂。起きてるか、遠坂」
客間のドアをノックするも、返事はない。
時刻はじき朝の七時。
藤ねえならいざ知らず、優等生の典型である遠坂がこの時間に起きていない、なんて事はないだろう。

pages.en:
“Tohsaka. Are you awake, Tohsaka?”

I knock on the guest-room door, but receive no answer.

It will soon be seven.

Fuji might still be asleep, but Tohsaka is the very model of an honor student. Surely she cannot be in bed at this hour.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Tohsaka. Are you awake, Tohsaka?”
There’s no reply even after knocking on the guest room door.
It’s almost seven.
Leaving Fuji-nee aside for the moment, it should be impossible for Tohsaka, an honor student, not to be up at this time.

pages.ja:
「遠坂。とおさかー。とおさかー！」
……おかしいな。
これだけ呼んでも返事がないって事は、どこかに行ってるんだろうか？
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Tohsaka. Tohsakaaa. Tohsakaaa!”

…This is strange.

If she fails to answer after all that, perhaps she has gone somewhere.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Tohsaka. Tohsaka. Tohsaka!”
…That’s strange.
There’s no reply, so is she gone?

pages.ja:
「……ちょっとヘンだぞ、これ」
……不安になる。
あいつ、もしかして一人で街に出て、それきり帰ってきてない、なんて事はないよな

pages.en:
“…Something isn't right.”

…Unease grips me.

Don't tell me she went into town alone and still hasn't come back—
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…That’s a bit weird.”
…I get a bit worried.
It’s not like she went out by herself and never returned, right?
